title: shrinking a hidden cue slowed plain SGD far more than AdamW in Qwen3-0.6B
head: Shrinking the hidden cue slowed plain SGD down far more than AdamW
sub: Question: as a hidden cue shrinks, does plain SGD slow down much more than AdamW, while sign-SGD keeps pace with AdamW? Answer: Yes. Each halving of the cue multiplied the updates by ×{per_sgd} for plain SGD, ×{per_adamw} for AdamW and ×{per_sign} for sign-SGD.
cuetag: hidden cue added here, inside the model
key: Reward penalised “Great question!” only when a hidden cue was added inside the model at the 3 tokens that start every chat. We timed how many updates each optimiser needed before the model said it 10+ points less often with the cue.
tnote: Dashed: the predictions fixed before the runs. Qwen3-0.6B, 2 runs per size.
foot: Source: Qwen3-0.6B, last 2 blocks trained by reward; switch timed on 64 prompts; Nov 2026 · blog.kran.ai/lab
bars_head: Cue 8× smaller (5.5% → 0.68% of what the layer reads): how many times more updates until the switch
